headline: "It can be confidently asserted": heating prices have most likely already reached their highest level
summary: Heating prices in Lithuania have most likely already reached their highest level, so a larger increase over the coming winter months is considered unlikely. The statement was reported by Respublika.
why: Heating costs are a major component of household energy bills and feed into consumer price inflation.
